The best pair on garnet is QB12 and QB11. Its IRB CZ fidelity is 0.99869, with an uncertainty of about 0.00035. The metric is metrics.irb.cz.slepian_crf.QB12__QB11.fidelity:par=d2. It comes from garnet's current default calibration set, f81c45da-6e73-4b5d-a0fe-72c75635fade. That set has 28 IRB CZ values. The second-best pair is QB12 and QB7 at 0.99802.

I ran a Bell circuit on garnet:mock with 100 shots on exactly QB12 and QB11. The circuit used H then CNOT, transpiled with restrict_to_qubits=["QB12","QB11"]. Before submitting, I checked the run request. It has cz on (QB12, QB11) and measures QB12 and QB11, and it touches no other qubit.

Job 01a15fa0-11f2-7380-a909-bb95c4a8921c completed. The counts were 00: 22, 01: 28, 10: 29, 11: 21. The mock returns random results, so the counts are spread evenly and do not show Bell correlation. The mock used its own calibration set, f04fe114-002f-46bd-8fa4-2a577ff56501.

One note on the first try: transpile with initial_layout=[11, 10] produced a CZ on QB19 and QB20. My pre-submit check caught it, so that circuit was never sent.
